name: statusbar
description: A session status bar for Claude Code Desktop: your 5-hour and weekly usage limits with time to reset, session and turn clocks, and running subagents, background tasks and scheduled wakeups (early access).

surfaces.title: Where to show the bar
surfaces.description: desktop shows it only in the Claude Desktop Code tab, where the statusLine setting does not run; all shows it in the terminal too.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Add the session's cost in USD, as /cost totals it.
